    projects

    VQA: Asking Questions About Image Content

    Date: August 23, 2022

    A multimodal Visual Question Answering project combining CNN/ViT image encoders with LSTM/GRU/BERT language models.

    SOTD: Secure Online Telemedicine dApp with Blockchain

    Date: August 30, 2022

    A blockchain and IPFS-enabled telemedicine architecture for secure medical record sharing and trusted service workflows.

    AICVTG: Automatic Image Captioning

    Date: January 20, 2023

    An image captioning project using a Vision Transformer encoder and GPT-2 decoder on the MSCOCO dataset.

    SPARC: Spotify Audio-Feature Analysis

    Date: October 25, 2026

    A reproducible study of Spotify track data using least-squares regression, PCA/SVD, exploratory analysis, and supplementary classification and clustering.

    SatScene: Satellite Land-Use Classification

    Date: October 25, 2026

    A 14-class overhead-image classification project using fine-tuned ConvNeXt-Tiny, paired with a rule-based agent that suggests follow-up geospatial analyses.
